You will join a small, autonomous DevOps team (part of a wider 8-person Infrastructure, Data, and QA organization) running a stable, production-grade AWS/Kubernetes platform, with room to improve it step by step. Your core mission is to simplify the developers' world—building the automation and reliability that allows engineering teams to deliver features seamlessly to production. Debug issues safely, transfer knowledge to engineers, raise risks proactively, and partner across teams to plan and integrate new tools along project timelines. Solid IaC Practice: Strong hands-on experience with Terraform / OpenTofu. CI/CD & GitOps: Experience with CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD). Security Fundamentals: Good grasp of AWS security fundamentals (IAM, roles, networking). Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Monitoring and alerting experience, paired with the ability to troubleshoot and root-cause production issues. Pragmatic Collaborator: Excellent communication skills and high emotional and professional maturity. Quality & Architectural Awareness: A track record of high-quality work as evaluated by peers, with the ability to anticipate how your contributions affect the larger architecture, risk mitigation, and contingency plans.
